purpose: Prepare a bounded comparison of transfer across the original two reserve tasks using the native Claude stack. This draft authorizes no solver/provider or CI execution.

prepared.scope: Local preparation evidence; future execution must reproduce or retain and verify these exact identities before authorization.

selection: Reuse q002 and q003 together, without replacement. These are previously selected reserve development tasks with already observed custom-stack results, not fresh holdouts. The new comparison concerns transfer of the native stack to different tasks; preserve all earlier adverse results separately and do not pool them.
execution_topology: One independent fresh GitHub runner per task pair, with two serial profile slots in the declared order. All four trials use distinct fresh containers/home/sessions/native-installation volumes; zg indexes are built fresh. No shared runner/cache/index across tasks. No rerun, replacement, or extra trial.
configuration: Inherit the base native model, agent/version/effort, endpoint, runtime, Rust candidate, budget/time limits, embedding configuration, native guidance and execution/accounting behavior unchanged. For each task use its own original frozen source commit, question and rubric from the pinned dataset; do not substitute q001 data or change a prompt.

grading_contract.required_before_execution: Host review and a separately recorded prospective freeze before any new expansion answers. Host-only: never source/image/MCP index/solver prompt. Preserve every original task-specific quality/core/citation/contradiction gate.

primary.name: reported-input benefit across both original reserve tasks
each_task_conditions: Both executions, exact task/source/question/runtime identities and independent source-only/no-web/tool-scope audits are valid.
Both exact final answers pass that task’s original rubric: >=8/10, full task-specific core criteria, valid actual core citations, and no disqualifying contradiction. Structural reward is not quality.
zg factual points are at least baseline points.

Both sole successful expected-model terminal modelUsage records contain all four finite nonnegative usage fields and no contradiction to complete persisted evidence. Retain the actual corroboration status.
zg reported input is strictly lower than baseline, using inputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens + cacheCreationInputTokens. outputTokens is required and reported separately; it is not added to input.
At least one actual successful, materially relevant zg retrieval uses the correct /workspace root and frozen task source.
primary.group_rule: Every condition must hold separately on both q002 and q003. Do not average away a failed task, select a favorable subset, pool q001 development/confirmation, substitute sensitivity grades, retry, replace tasks or modify prompts to pass.

secondary.quality_candidate: Report per task under the original independent definition: both executions valid; zg passes while baseline fails; zg points>=baseline; successful relevant correct-root retrieval. Keep this separate from primary reported-input success.
secondary.accounting: Keep Claude-reported per-model aggregate and strict persisted root/child accounting separate. No zero-filling, result.usage fallback or child-metadata addition. Report four components and corroboration/coverage limits; do not assert provider billing or complete provider/background coverage.
secondary.time: Report native execution, setup/index, audit/export, Harbor intervals, outer slot and collection as separate scopes. Any whole-two-task observed outer-slot reduction requires each task’s zg outer slot to decrease; no whole-workflow or generalized causal-time claim.
secondary.cost: Embedding and provider monetary costs remain unknown; token and wall measurements are not billing.
secondary.history: q001 development, current q001 confirmation and all previous custom/OpenCode outcomes remain separately labeled and are never pooled into this expansion result.

execution_prerequisites.confirmation_requirement: Both predeclared q001 confirmation pairs must finish and be retained with independent execution/source audits, blinded grades and final conclusion. Bind the exact conclusion/report path and SHA here before any expansion execution; no positive outcome is assumed by this draft.
execution_prerequisites.approval_requirement: A subsequent host execution decision made by root within the active user goal’s existing authorization is required after inspecting the retained confirmation conclusion. This is not a request for additional user confirmation. Once the predeclared prerequisites are satisfied, root may make and record that decision and continue. Preparation/driver work and this draft alone are not paid-run authorization.
execution_prerequisites.upstream_requirement: Record a fresh current-upstream check against a424e0ce06868dc9ad8f142f57de59b8f9b58699 before authorization; do not silently move the base revision.
execution_prerequisites.freeze_requirement: After prerequisites and review, separately freeze the final plan/decision, host grading contract and executable workflow/driver hashes. The runner must reject this draft status/frozen=false, missing prerequisite bindings or mismatched inputs.

stopping: Stop after the two scheduled task pairs and their independent audits, retaining all failures and partial results. Cleanup uncertainty blocks the next slot on that runner. No retries, favorable replacements or post-outcome changes; any new phase requires its own prospective decision.
limits: Two purposively selected, previously observed development tasks do not establish a representative favorable benchmark set, contamination freedom, immutable model weights or broad causal benefit.
ci_scope: Any later approved development CI is restricted to Cuiyus/zvec-grep. Upstream access is read-only source/existing artifact retrieval.
current_confirmation_isolation: The current q001 confirmation protocol, schedule, answers and results are untouched. This draft was prepared without reading its answers.
